logros.main.title: Achievements
logros.main.subtitle: Our journey building the "OP" race car and representing the UAM.

items.title: Best Performance in Virtual Modality
items.description: Earned the highest evaluation during Formula SAE's virtual stage, distinguished by our engineering rigor, CAD simulations, and technical defense.

items.title: 3<sup class='lowercase'>rd</sup> Place in Costs Event
items.description: In our debut year, we secured a podium finish in the Costs Event, proving our budget efficiency, manufacturing optimization, and overall economic feasibility.

items.title: Top 5 Overall Standing
items.description: Secured a Top-5 finish in the Formula SAE Mexico overall championship, cementing UAMOTORS' standing among the premier university racing teams nationwide.
